# Weather client

The weather client fetches forecasts from the command line.

Get a first forecast in three steps:

1. Install the client with `pip install weather-client`.
2. Set `WEATHER_KEY` to your API key.
3. Run `weather today`.

Every option sits in one table:

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--units` | metric or imperial |
| `--city` | city name |

The documentation covers the rest.

- [Tutorial](docs/tutorials/first-forecast.md)
- [Reference](docs/reference/cli.md)
